en: Thank you for checking in with me, $c. We now have all of the thorium bars that we'll need, but you may want to ask some of the others here that are in charge of different collection efforts.
Yes, Augustus.  I would like to do business.
What kind of services?
%s chirps a goodbye to $n.
It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?

Be steadfast, champion. I know why it is that you are here and I know what it is that you seek. Eranikus will not give up the shard freely. He has been twisted... twisted by the same force that you seek to destroy.
When I grow up, I wanna be the king of Stormwind!
The goblins win the drag race!  Better luck next time, gnome team.
We're here to make a profit.  And having our goods stolen is no way to make a profit.
%s places a poultice on Relara's brow.
Go back to your Lich King, foul creatures!

I'm not out of the belly of this beast for more than two minutes and someone is already asking me about my bathroom behavior??? $G Mister:Missy;, I'd have smacked you silly for that question had you not been the one to rescue me!$B$BAnyhow! I'm grateful for the assistance. Maybe I can pay you back?
Whoa!...Whoa!...Ahh!  That was close.  Whoops!...Oh the pain, dear boy the pain!
I need a few good wing men to get me out of here safely and back to base.
Dat should do it good...
OW! That's not right!
Hey Pratt - can you teach me how to make a Wild Leather Cloak?

Greetings, $r. The war materiel is on its way and should be at Cenarion Hold within a day's time. We can only hope that once it is there that someone, having assembled the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, will step forward to ring the gong and open the gates.
Aha!  There it is.
Alright! Alright! We surrender... Just put your weapons down, I'll cooperate!
May your elders bless you, $n, and bring you luck in the coming year.
Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!
If you are looking to become a mighty paladin, there is no better teacher then Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker. He can be found in the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square.
Die, $R!  These lands belong to the Stonesplinter Tribe!
What's happening?
Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...
Praise Elune! I don't know if I could have survived the day without you, friend.
Get it over with you filthy $r.$B$B<Kharan lowers his head, exposing his stubby neck.>
You seek to harm me, $r?

Tower Point East holds the pass between the Field of Strife and Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.The East Frostwolf Tower protects the gate between Frostwolf Village and Frostwolf Keep.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.
I have lost my Scythe of the Unseen Path. Are you able to replace it for me?
Now you're gonna get it good, $n!
Here come the beasts!
looks very sleepy...
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter III.
%s arrives!
By Orgrim!  This indurium can withstand massive heat!
You are ready for greater things! See Franklin Lloyd, to my right. He will guide you from now on.
Welcome to Revantusk Village, stranger. I am Primal Torntusk, leader of the Revantusk trolls.
Come back Fluffy!
If there is anything you would have of me...
